geological_stratigraphy_section.title: PERFIL GEOLÓGICO Y PROFUNDIDAD

overburden_stress_vectors.why: three horizontal layers, five red downward arrows, a vertical percentage scale, a dashed yellow line at 100%, and a solid orange line at 114%
overburden_stress_vectors.subject: Vertical force arrows press downward into the clay layer, triggering a signal-orange threshold marker indicating a 14% overburden above safe allowable stress.
overburden_stress_vectors.title: EXCESO DE CARGA ADMISIBLE

pore_water_consolidation.why: a cluster of grey ovals within a dark rectangle, three red downward arrows at the top, six blue horizontal arrows pointing outward from the sides, a dashed line indicating a previous height, and a scale bar.
pore_water_consolidation.subject: A microscopic void cross-section compresses under vertical load arrows, driving horizontal water-expulsion vectors out of clay pores as layer thickness decreases.
pore_water_consolidation.title: CONSOLIDACIÓN POR EXPULSIÓN HÍDRICA

underpinning_pile_scheme.why: Vertical yellow bars extending from a 0m mark, past a -24m mark, down to a large brown block at a -76m mark on a vertical axis.
underpinning_pile_scheme.subject: 52 new end-bearing steel pile shafts extend past the original 24m friction piles to anchor directly into Franciscan bedrock at -76m.
underpinning_pile_scheme.title: ANCLAJE A ROCA FIRME

coring_confinement_loss.why: A cross-section of soil layers with a central auger inside dashed lines, horizontal red arrows pointing inward labeled 'σ_h', and vertical yellow arrows pointing downward at the surface.
coring_confinement_loss.subject: An auger extraction section shows lateral confinement vectors collapsing into the open pile casing, driving local settlement arrows around the collar highlighted in signal orange.
coring_confinement_loss.title: PÉRDIDA DE CONFINAMIENTO LATERAL

total_roof_displacement.why: a tilted rectangle containing a grid, a vertical dashed line, a central yellow axis line, and a horizontal dimension line at the top labeled '55 cm'.
total_roof_displacement.subject: A vertical tower profile aligns an ideal plumb baseline against the tilted building axis, dimensioning a 55cm horizontal offset at the roof line.
total_roof_displacement.title: DESVIACIÓN DE EJE VERTICAL

vertical_load_distribution.why: a rectangle with horizontal lines, four vertical bars extending into two distinct ground layers (the bottom one hatched), and four yellow downward-pointing arrows on the bars.
vertical_load_distribution.subject: Schnittzeichnung des Gebäudes mit vertikalen Lastpfeilen, die durch die Pfähle in die untere, dunkler schraffierte Bodenschicht zeigen.
vertical_load_distribution.title: SOLL-ZUSTAND DER GRÜNDUNG

pile_cross_section.why: a grey hatched ring with a central black void, eight small yellow circles embedded in the ring, a dimension line for the outer diameter (400 mm), and a dimension line for the wall thickness (80 mm).
pile_cross_section.subject: Detaillierter Querschnitt eines Pfahls mit Maßketten für den Durchmesser und die Wandstärke in technischem Grau.
pile_cross_section.title: SPEZIFIKATION PHC-PFAHL

site_pressure_gradient.why: a cross-section with three horizontal layers, a terrain profile line with a 10m high embankment, a 4.6m deep section, and a large horizontal yellow arrow.
site_pressure_gradient.subject: Geländeprofil im Schnitt mit Bemaßung der 10m-Aufschüttung und der 4,6m-Grube sowie einem großen horizontalen Druckvektor.
site_pressure_gradient.title: ASYMMETRISCHE BODENBELASTUNG

soil_fluidization.why: three horizontal layers of different shades, three vertical bars intersecting them, horizontal red arrows pointing at the first bar, and curved yellow lines in the middle layer.
soil_fluidization.subject: Schnitt durch die Bodenschichten, in dem sich die Textur der Mittelschicht verändert und Pfeile den lateralen Druck auf die Pfahlreihe visualisieren.
soil_fluidization.title: HYDROSTATISCHER BODENDRUCK

lateral_soil_displacement.why: three horizontal layers of different colors, vertical downward arrows on the top layer, a sequence of horizontal and upward-curving arrows within the middle layer, and a horizontal scale with meter markings.
lateral_soil_displacement.subject: Vektordiagramm, das die Verschiebung der Bodenmasse von der Aufschüttung unter dem Gebäude hindurch zur Grube zeigt.
lateral_soil_displacement.title: LATERALER BODENFLUSS

structural_vulnerability.why: two vertical rectangles on a ground line next to a vertical scale, one with a vertical yellow arrow pointing down and the other with a horizontal red arrow pointing into its side at an orange zigzag symbol
structural_vulnerability.subject: Vergleich zweier Pfahlsegmente: Eines mit hohem vertikalem Lastpfeil (stabil) und eines mit horizontalem Pfeil und orangefarbenem Bruchpunkt.
structural_vulnerability.title: BELASTUNGSGRENZEN (SCHERUNG)
